clusters.title: Diesel / harvest / food logistics

clusters.title: Sulfur / phosphate / farm nutrient access
clusters.status: Producer-level physical curtailment corroborated; farm-order and yield cascade conditional
clusters.interaction: Sulfur input strain can squeeze phosphate margins while potash has stronger output; neither proves all-nutrient shortage.

clusters.adaptation: Preserve safe restart capability and worker income; improve nutrient-specific procurement and input efficiency without assuming interchangeable nutrients.

clusters.title: Local utility recovery / equipment / water and care continuity

clusters.donor_note: Removed Europe/Caribbean as generic local utility rescue links. Re-add only with a specific compatible asset, route, current commitments and protected donor reserve.
